thread:
Dina: Quick drop  promo-evidence microcards  tiny, copy-paste friendly for self-reviews and manager notes. Paste below.

Raj: Love quick formats. Can you show both IC and manager lines?

Dina: Sure  two compact blocks. IC elevator (4 lines max):
```
Goal: <one-line goal>
Outcome: <one-line metric or customer impact>
Evidence: <one-sentence impact + artifact link (opt)>
Behavioral signal: <one-line e.g., led cross-team, coached X>
Ask (opt): <one-line support needed>
```

Dina: Promo-evidence micro-card (single line to paste into packet):
"Impact: <one-sentence outcome>. Scope: <team/org>. Repeatable: <yes/no>. Artifact: <link>"

Maya: Peer micro-feedback (one line):
"Observed: <impact>. Example: <specific>. Suggest: <next step>."

LeadB: I'll include the promo line in calibration notes. Can you add a tiny rubric note for reviewers?

Dina: Added rubrics as 3 short bullets in the shared paste: 1) Outcome clear, 2) Scope quantified, 3) Evidence reproducible. Keeping it one-liner in the card.

HR-bot: Uploaded: /drive/people-ops/promo-evidence-microcards-v1.txt (org access) :white_check_mark:

Raj: Super helpful. Will pilot in my team reviews this week and report back.

Dina: Great  shout if you want CSV for bulk import or a prettier PDF.
